# Which roles answer a shadow, a lift and a transition?

Read this when your style plugin answers the depth a surface casts, how far a control lifts or presses, or how long and how smooth a change runs.

**The steps live in [`effects.json`](../../../../../contracts/design/effects.json)** for these:

| Roles | Scale |
|---|---|
| `shadow-*` | `shadow` |
| `dur-*`, `ease-*` | `dur`, `ease` |

**Two roles read no scale at all**, and a literal is the only answer for them: `lift-control` and `press-scale`.

<!-- @tree GENERATED by bun run generate:token-tree. Edit that script, not this copy. -->

| role | type | user scale | default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--dur-hover` | duration | none | none |
| `--dur-state` | duration | none | none |
| `--ease-hover` | cubicBezier | none | none |
| `--ease-state` | cubicBezier | none | none |
| `--lift-control` | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--press-scale` | number | none | none |
| `--shadow-control-raised` | shadow | none | none |
| `--shadow-control-rest` | shadow | none | none |
| `--shadow-surface-deep` | shadow | none | none |
| `--shadow-surface-floating` | shadow | none | none |
| `--shadow-surface-rest` | shadow | none | none |
